edits.text: When a user's request includes multiple database changes, you must list the details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) for each change before calling the corresponding tool.
edits.reason: Ensures policy compliance by requiring explicit confirmation for every distinct database change when multiple changes are requested.

edits.text: Before calling `modify_pending_order_items`, check if the order's status is 'pending (item modified)' or if the price difference has already been paid in the `payment_history`. If so, do not call the tool and inform the user that the modification has already been completed and cannot be changed.
edits.reason: Prevents the agent from attempting to modify an order that has already been processed.

edits.text: When proposing a modification to a pending order where multiple variants meet the user's specified requirements, you must only propose the variant that matches the original item's attributes unless the user specifies a different value for those attributes.
edits.reason: Prevents the agent from proposing multiple variants, which led to incorrect refund calculations in previous tasks.

edits.text: When a user's request to modify an item is ambiguous because there are multiple items of the same type in the order, you must ask the user to clarify which specific item they want to modify before proposing any changes.
edits.reason: Prevents errors caused by the agent selecting the wrong item when multiple items of the same type are present in an order.
